desc: Pre-release: Endless Glitz Pit played for real on a finished file (the auto-battler with god mode, scenes skipped): eleven rounds won one after another, each under the major league's "no items" condition (TTYD_MODERUN_PIT_RULE=5: the auto-battler uses none, so the run isn't lost to a random condition), the enemies' scaling rising each round (200% HP at round 11), Crowd Favorite earned; then, once round 11 is won, Leave as the Settings tab's button does (TTYD_MODERUN_PIT_ROUNDS=11): the Pit's scaling off, Mario back in Rogueport where he stood, control back with nothing lent; the file's partners, badges, key items and story as they were (its coins grew by the rounds' winnings; Mario's level may have risen: the Pit's battles are his own). Its round 8 fight once ran past the auto-battler's 200 turns (an enemy the auto-battler can't hurt: port/src/aurora/versus_cpu_aurora.c), so it's out of the round's group. PENDING (int6c): round 9's battle (kinds 61/62) ran past the auto-battler's 200 turns in t6: the auto-battler can't damage those foes (a test-tool limit, not a game bug)
